scope: Prospective extension; original guards and completed evidence remain frozen. No new helper qualified yet.

entries.preserve: Keep the frozen full SHA/MD5/framing/header/feature/granularity/snapshot and immutable-file checks. Decoder EOF alone is insufficient.
entries.screenExtension: Continuous exact12,229,320,016-byte whole-source pre/post identity and framed guards each pass; source file/mount immutable.
entries.newRequiredControls: framing/hash/decoder drift, unsupported headers, exact normal/error EOF

entries.preserve: Native receipt counters before validation; positive signed64 IDs/version, strict typed order, duplicate rejection, all per-type/total quotas. Do not filter before validation.
entries.screenExtension: u64 per-type/pass/two-pass receipts and checked cumulative byte/ref/member/codec counters; no restart resets.
entries.newRequiredControls: 2**31/2**32/near-u64 boundaries, count caps+1, before-validation rejected receipts

entries.preserve: Same complete native timestamp/calendar/whole-second/UTC/shape/snapshot/visible rules as the frozen projector and validator; no rejection of valid epoch0 merely because a native Timestamp bool is false.
entries.screenExtension: Same metadata validation before dropping node/way/relation projections.
entries.newRequiredControls: all retained timestamp/visibility negatives on discarded objects

entries.preserve: Exact native signed XY32 lattice and range, IEEE binary64 division in round-to-nearest, no fast-math/rounding; compare bits to reference. Preserve original framing precision rejection.
entries.screenExtension: All source blocks native roundtrip; bounded passB source ID/XY witnesses separately compare lookup binary64 bits.
entries.newRequiredControls: lattice extremes, missing witness, swapped axes, index drift

entries.preserve: Validate accessed UTF-8 fields exactly as native-to-Python conversion; reject duplicate tag keys. Same incremental native-view copy charges; preserve all raw keys/values, not user/uid fields that old projection never copied.
entries.screenExtension: Suppress ordinary mixed-object Python projections only after full UTF8/tag/copy validation and GPF1 sealing.
entries.newRequiredControls: discarded invalid tags/strings, duplicate keys, copy charges

entries.preserve: Count exact canonical ASCII-escaped string/key/ref/member/integer/timestamp syntax natively. For node floats use a proven32-byte upper bound per finite float; accept safely below cap, reject safely above the lower bound, send only ambiguous near-limit nodes to the frozen Python canonical-size check via a bounded integer-XY frame. No approximate reject or C++ float formatting substitute.
entries.screenExtension: Retain exact near-cap Python fallback, bounded/count-limited; all-field semantic hashing stays streamed.

entries.preserve: Positive ordered way references (at least2); valid typed positive members/roles; retain unresolved outside references exactly.
entries.screenExtension: Validate every ref/member; choose bounded range-eligible actual highway references, never silently ignore missing dependencies.
entries.newRequiredControls: invalid refs before selection, unresolved range hits, trace caps/exclusions

entries.preserve: Generic unchanged21 windows, crossing/outside-node closure and relevant restrictions; separate native audit geometry/membership; retained raw/output/occurrence/heap caps unchanged.
entries.screenExtension: No21-window selection/extraction this screen; source-ordinal index sample and fixed way priority are probe only.
entries.newRequiredControls: exact census/strata/remap and selector proof; old independent geometry audit still required later

entries.preserve: Acquired-file SHA/immutable checks plus lossless per-pass semantic seals, counts and independently rebuilt block equality; selected canonical JSON/geometry hashes stay byte-identical to reference.
entries.screenExtension: Two whole GPF1/count/census passes, source-built rolling mini replacement and typed source witnesses.
entries.newRequiredControls: late failure, source/metadata/trace drift, omitted blocks, untrusted partial closure

entries.preserve: C ABI primitives/length-prefixed buffers only; exceptions caught, callback lifetimes fixed, callback errors stop. Same worker cgroup/time/storage/process ownership controls; no extra container resources during execution.
entries.screenExtension: New ABI/summary sink/reader queues; same isolation and exact owned lifecycle; full queried-shard authentication remains.
entries.newRequiredControls: actual target callback/counter/thread tests, hard watchdog, cap/OOM/error/removal/refusal tests
